prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: isolated panoramic architectural photograph for a Dream Clean housekeeping homepage; only the photograph, no webpage or UI.
Primary request: generate a new high-resolution photorealistic sunlit living room opening onto a clean cream kitchen, closely matching the composition, warmth and restrained natural palette of the provided reference image.
Input images: Image 1 is a composition reference crop only; generate a fresh photograph matching its scene arrangement.
Composition/framing: panoramic landscape around 3:1 aspect ratio, request at least 2304 by 768 pixels if possible. Eye-level architectural photography. Tall black-framed sunlit windows and leafy trees outside on the left. Cream linen sofa dominates the lower-left with neutral pillows and a pale knitted throw. A tall leafy olive-like indoor plant behind sofa near center-left, simple framed landscape on the cream rear wall. Low rustic natural wood rectangular coffee table near lower center with a ceramic vase of leafy branches, pale books and shallow wooden bowl. Large cream kitchen island with pale stone countertop and three wood stools occupies middle-to-right rear. Cream cabinets and subdued stone backsplash behind it, two white pendant shades with small brass fittings overhead. Warm oak plank floor with clear soft sunlight and shadows across the right foreground. Open doorway and a black-framed glass exterior door deep rear right; subtle leafy plant and natural wood console at far right edge.
Lighting/mood: warm morning or afternoon daylight through the left windows, tranquil, welcoming, immaculate but lived-in, soft realistic shadows, natural photographic detail.
Materials/textures: linen upholstery, cream painted cabinetry, warm light oak flooring, rustic wood coffee table, woven neutral rug, ceramic vessels.
Constraints: no people; no text, lettering, logos, watermarks, borders, graphic overlays or user interface; maintain reference object positions and spacious horizontal framing; realistic architecture, straight verticals and believable furnishings. Deliver only the interior photograph.
